entries.name: ponytail
entries.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 7,473 star（日均约 1,068，相对存量增速 4.8%），累计 156,408 star、8,401 fork。窗口内被 fork 457 次，最近一次提交在 1 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 178 个、issue 200 个，109 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 7,473 stars over the last 7 days (~1,068/day, 4.8% of its base), now at 156,408 stars and 8,401 forks. 457 new forks in the window; last push 1 day(s) ago; 178 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 109 contributors.

intro.zh: 一个给 AI 编码助手装的技能：让它像组里最懒的资深工程师那样先读懂现有代码，能复用就不新写，一行能解决就不写五十行。配了 /ponytail-review 审查改动、/ponytail-audit 体检整个仓库，但校验、报错处理、安全和测试一样不少。
intro.en: A skill that makes your AI coding agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room: read the code that is already there, reuse the component you already have, write one line instead of fifty. It ships with /ponytail-review for a change and /ponytail-audit for a whole repo — without cutting validation, error handling, security or tests.

cardLine.zh: 让 AI 编码助手少写代码的技能：先读现有代码，能复用就不新写
cardLine.en: A skill that gets AI coding agents to write less code by reusing what exists

highlights.zh: /ponytail-review 会连同改动波及的代码一起读，检查 bug、安全、真实负载和缺失的测试
highlights.en: /ponytail-review reads the code your change touches, checking bugs, security, real load and missing tests

highlights.zh: /ponytail-audit 先梳理仓库入口、数据怎么流动、预期负载，再排优先级告诉你先修哪个
highlights.en: /ponytail-audit maps entry points, data flow and expected load, then ranks what to fix first

highlights.zh: 先理解问题、追踪真实调用链，再选最省的做法，对方案懒但对读代码不懒
highlights.en: It picks the laziest solution only after tracing the real flow — lazy about the fix, never about reading

highlights.zh: 规则不是最少 token：可以砍代码，但不砍校验、错误处理、安全和可访问性
highlights.en: The rule is not fewest tokens: cut code, never validation, error handling, security or accessibility

entries.name: Agent-Reach
entries.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 5,468 star（日均约 781，相对存量增速 5.9%），累计 92,351 star、8,100 fork。窗口内被 fork 532 次，最近一次提交在 21 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 71 个、issue 95 个，36 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 5,468 stars over the last 7 days (~781/day, 5.9% of its base), now at 92,351 stars and 8,100 forks. 532 new forks in the window; last push 21 day(s) ago; 71 PRs and 95 issues opened in the last 30 days; 36 contributors.

intro.zh: 给 AI Agent 装上「上网」能力的命令行工具：读网页、取 YouTube 字幕和 RSS，搜 Twitter、Reddit、B站、小红书、GitHub，大多走免费渠道，不用逐个申请 API Key。Cookie 只存本地，装完还能用 agent-reach doctor 体检哪个平台通、哪个不通。
intro.en: A CLI that gives your AI agent eyes on the internet: read web pages, pull YouTube subtitles and RSS, search Twitter, Reddit, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu and GitHub — mostly through free channels, without applying for API keys one by one. Cookies stay local, and agent-reach doctor tells you which platform works and which does not.

cardLine.zh: 一条命令给 AI Agent 接入推特、Reddit、YouTube、B站、小红书等平台的读取与搜索
cardLine.en: One CLI that lets AI agents read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili and more

highlights.zh: 网页、YouTube 字幕、RSS 装好即用，Twitter、B站、GitHub 等配置后解锁搜索与登录内容
highlights.en: Web pages, YouTube captions and RSS work out of the box; Twitter, Bilibili and GitHub unlock search after setup

highlights.zh: 每个平台都是首选加备选的多后端路由，某个接入方式失效就换下一个，用户无感
highlights.en: Each platform has a preferred plus fallback backend, so when one route dies the next takes over silently

highlights.zh: agent-reach doctor 一条命令诊断哪个平台通、哪个不通、该怎么修
highlights.en: agent-reach doctor diagnoses which platforms reach through, which fail, and how to fix it

highlights.zh: Cookie 只存在本地，代码开源可审查，且兼容任何能跑命令行的 Agent
highlights.en: Cookies stay on your machine, the code is open to audit, and any agent that can run a CLI can use it

cons.zh: 近 90 天未发布正式 Release 版本
cons.en: No formal releases in the last 90 days

entries.name: orca
entries.description: Orca is the ADE for working with a fleet of parallel agents. Run any coding agent with your own subscription. Available on desktop, mobile and remote runtime.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 4,390 star（日均约 627，相对存量增速 5.1%），累计 86,222 star、5,533 fork。窗口内被 fork 254 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，425 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 4,390 stars over the last 7 days (~627/day, 5.1% of its base), now at 86,222 stars and 5,533 forks. 254 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 425 contributors.

intro.zh: 一个面向「同时跑一堆 Agent」的开发者环境：Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode 等可以并排跑在各自的 git worktree 里，统一在一个窗口里看进度。桌面、手机和远程机器都能用，可以带自己的订阅账号。
intro.en: An ADE built for running a fleet of coding agents: Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode and others run side by side, each in its own git worktree, tracked in one place. It works from desktop, phone and a remote box, using your own subscription.

cardLine.zh: 并行跑多个编码 Agent 的开发环境：各自独立 worktree，桌面手机远程统一管理
cardLine.en: An ADE for fleets of parallel coding agents, each in its own worktree, on desktop, mobile and remote

highlights.zh: 并行 worktree：同一个提示词分给五个 Agent，各自在隔离工作区里跑，比完再合入赢家
highlights.en: Fan one prompt across five agents in isolated worktrees, compare the results and merge the winner

highlights.zh: 手机伴侣：随时看 Agent 跑完没有，结束会推送通知，还能直接补一句后续指令
highlights.en: Mobile companion: get notified when an agent finishes and send follow-ups from anywhere

highlights.zh: Design Mode 在真实 Chromium 窗口里点任意 UI 元素，把 HTML、CSS 和截图直接塞进提示词
highlights.en: Design Mode lets you click any UI element in a real Chromium window and send its HTML, CSS and screenshot into the prompt

highlights.zh: SSH worktree 在远程大机器上跑 Agent，带自动重连和端口转发，还能在 diff 上批注回传给 Agent
highlights.en: SSH worktrees run agents on a remote box with auto-reconnect and port forwarding; annotate diffs and ship comments back

cons.zh: 开放 issue 7,722 个，相对 star 规模偏高
cons.en: 7,722 open issues — high relative to its star count

entries.name: ECC
entries.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 4,072 star（日均约 582，相对存量增速 1.5%），累计 273,956 star、40,880 fork。窗口内被 fork 634 次，最近一次提交在 1 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，370 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 4,072 stars over the last 7 days (~582/day, 1.5% of its base), now at 273,956 stars and 40,880 forks. 634 new forks in the window; last push 1 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 370 contributors.

intro.zh: 给编码 Agent 装一套「工程流程」的插件：先规划再动手，用测试验证改动，换个干净上下文自我审查，把重复的成功做法沉淀成可复用的技能。装一次而不是在每个提示词里重写流程，支持 Claude Code、Codex，也为 Cursor、OpenCode 等提供适配。
intro.en: A harness optimization system that gives your coding agent a coordinated engineering process: plan before building, verify changes with tests, review its own work from a fresh context, and turn repeated wins into reusable skills. Install it once instead of rebuilding the process in every prompt; it works best with Claude Code and has adapters for others.

cardLine.zh: 给编码 Agent 装上规划、验证、审查、记忆等工程流程与工具箱的系统
cardLine.en: A system that gives coding agents planning, verification, review and memory workflows

highlights.zh: 把先规划、测试验证、换干净上下文自审、记忆沉淀串成一套可复用流程
highlights.en: Chains planning, test verification, fresh-context self-review and memory into one reusable process

highlights.zh: 自带技能与 Agent 库，外加 hooks、rules、记忆和持续学习机制
highlights.en: Ships a large library of agents and skills plus hooks, rules, memory and continuous learning

highlights.zh: 内置 AgentShield 安全扫描，给 Agent 工作流多一层检查
highlights.en: Includes AgentShield security scanning as an extra check on agent workflows

highlights.zh: 以 Claude Code 为主，提供 Codex 同步路径和 Cursor、OpenCode、Gemini 等的能力受限适配
highlights.en: Best on Claude Code, with a supported Codex sync path and capability-limited adapters for Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini and others

entries.description: Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 3,719 star（日均约 531，相对存量增速 5.7%），累计 65,051 star、11,205 fork。窗口内被 fork 735 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 62 个、issue 86 个，22 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 3,719 stars over the last 7 days (~531/day, 5.7% of its base), now at 65,051 stars and 11,205 forks. 735 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 62 PRs and 86 issues opened in the last 30 days; 22 contributors.

intro.zh: 一门从零开始的 AI 工程课程：自己动手实现模型内部结构、检索管线和 Agent 运行时，跟着跑测试、看失败原因，并把代码和评测结果留下来。可以在网站上学，也可以让编码 Agent 带着你学，覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Rust、Julia。
intro.en: An AI engineering curriculum you build from scratch: implement model internals, retrieval pipelines and agent runtimes yourself, test them, inspect failures and keep the code and evaluation results. Learn on the website, with a coding agent, or by running code locally — in Python, TypeScript, Rust or Julia.

cardLine.zh: 从零动手实现模型内部、检索管线与 Agent 运行时的 AI 工程课程
cardLine.en: A from-scratch curriculum on model internals, retrieval pipelines and agent runtimes

highlights.zh: 分三条学习路线：模型基础、LLM 系统、Agent 与交付，可按起点直接进入
highlights.en: Three learning routes — model foundations, LLM systems, and agents and delivery — each with a starting lesson

highlights.zh: 项目式练习带分阶段 starter、参考实现和本地评分器，先跑不过再自己补齐
highlights.en: Project challenges come with staged starters, reference implementations and local graders that fail until you fill them in

highlights.zh: 覆盖 Python、TypeScript、Rust、Julia，网站、编码 Agent、本地跑代码三种学法都行
highlights.en: Covers Python, TypeScript, Rust and Julia, and can be studied on the site, with a coding agent, or locally

highlights.zh: 带可交互实验，例如调学习率看梯度下降、对比 GD、动量与 Adam
highlights.en: Interactive labs let you adjust the learning rate and compare GD, momentum and Adam in code

entries.name: firecrawl
entries.description: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond. Building the library for superintelligence. 🔥

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 2,397 star（日均约 342，相对存量增速 1.3%），累计 189,059 star、10,037 fork。窗口内被 fork 58 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，166 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 2,397 stars over the last 7 days (~342/day, 1.3% of its base), now at 189,059 stars and 10,037 forks. 58 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 166 contributors.

intro.zh: Firecrawl 是一个开源的网页数据抓取工具，专门给 AI Agent 喂数据：把任意网址转成干净的 Markdown、结构化 JSON 或截图，代理轮换、JS 渲染、限流这些脏活都由它处理。你既可以用官方托管服务拿 API Key，也能一条命令把它接进任意 Agent 或 MCP 客户端，让 Agent 实时上网取数。
intro.en: Firecrawl is an open-source web data tool for AI agents: it turns any URL into clean markdown, structured JSON or screenshots, handling proxies, JS rendering and rate limits for you. Use the hosted service with an API key, or wire it into any agent or MCP client with a single command so your agent can pull live web data.

cardLine.zh: 把任意网站变成 Agent 能直接吃的干净 Markdown 和结构化数据
cardLine.en: Turns any website into LLM-ready markdown or structured JSON for your agents.

highlights.zh: Scrape 把任意 URL 转成 Markdown、HTML、截图或结构化 JSON，省下大量 token
highlights.en: Scrape converts any URL into markdown, HTML, screenshots or structured JSON, saving tokens

highlights.zh: Search、Crawl、Map 和批量抓取：一次请求爬完整站、发现全部链接、异步抓上千 URL
highlights.en: Search, Crawl, Map and batch scrape: crawl a whole site, list all its URLs, or scrape thousands asynchronously

highlights.zh: Interact 先抓页面，再用 AI 指令或代码点击、滚动、输入，然后才提取内容
highlights.en: Interact scrapes a page, then clicks, scrolls and types via AI prompts or code before extracting

highlights.zh: 能解析网页上的 PDF、DOCX，并可一条命令接入任意 Agent 或 MCP 客户端
highlights.en: Parses web-hosted PDFs and DOCX, and connects to any agent or MCP client in one command

cons.en: No dedicated docs portal — onboarding relies primarily on README

entries.name: pi
entries.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 2,261 star（日均约 323，相对存量增速 2%），累计 112,857 star、14,327 fork。窗口内被 fork 302 次，最近一次提交在 0 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，291 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 2,261 stars over the last 7 days (~323/day, 2% of its base), now at 112,857 stars and 14,327 forks. 302 new forks in the window; last push 0 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 291 contributors.

intro.zh: Pi 是一个极简、可扩展的 AI Agent 骨架，自带统一的 LLM 接口、Agent 循环、TUI 界面和编码 Agent 命令行。它不硬塞 sub-agent、plan mode 这类功能，而是让你用扩展、技能、提示模板自己拼装。在项目目录里启动 Pi，登录模型后就能直接让它改代码。
intro.en: Pi is a minimal, extensible agent harness that bundles a unified LLM API, an agent loop, a TUI and a coding-agent CLI. Instead of forcing features like sub-agents or plan mode on you, it lets you assemble your own via extensions, skills and prompt templates. Start it in your project directory, log in to a model, and hand it a coding task.

cardLine.zh: 极简可扩展的 Agent 骨架：统一 LLM 接口、Agent 循环、TUI 与编码 CLI
cardLine.en: A minimal, extensible agent harness with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding CLI.

highlights.zh: 用扩展、技能、提示模板和主题定制 Agent，打包成 Pi package 通过 npm 或 git 分享
highlights.en: Customize it with extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes, then share them as Pi packages via npm or git

highlights.zh: 既能交互式使用，也能跑 print 或 JSON 模式做自动化，还能通过 RPC 被外部控制
highlights.en: Use it interactively, automate it in print or JSON mode, or drive it over RPC

highlights.zh: 提供 TypeScript SDK，可以把 Agent 循环嵌进自己的应用里
highlights.en: A TypeScript SDK lets you embed the agent loop inside your own app

highlights.zh: 默认跳过 sub-agent 和 plan mode，需要什么能力由你自己决定装什么
highlights.en: Skips sub-agents and plan mode by default, so you install only the capabilities you want

fitFor.zh: 要把 Agent 能力嵌进自己产品的开发者
fitFor.en: Developers embedding agent capabilities into their own product

fitFor.zh: 需要可扩展抽象层而非端到端方案的团队
fitFor.en: Teams wanting an extensible abstraction layer rather than a turnkey app

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 earendil-works/pi 的 README
curl -fsSL https://pi.dev/install.sh | sh

entries.name: agency-agents
entries.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 2,020 star（日均约 289，相对存量增速 1.3%），累计 157,542 star、25,402 fork。窗口内被 fork 365 次，最近一次提交在 2 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 199 个、issue 200 个，99 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 2,020 stars over the last 7 days (~289/day, 1.3% of its base), now at 157,542 stars and 25,402 forks. 365 new forks in the window; last push 2 day(s) ago; 199 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 99 contributors.

intro.zh: 一个 AI「专家库」：每个 Agent 都有自己的专长、性格和工作流程，从写前端到做社区运营、从注入趣味到泼冷水做现实检查都有对应角色。可以直接把挑好的角色装进 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、Gemini 等工具里用。
intro.en: A roster of AI specialist personalities: each agent has a domain of expertise, a distinct voice and a working process — from frontend wizard to community operator, from whimsy injector to reality checker. Pick the ones you need and install them into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and other tools.

cardLine.zh: 一群带性格和工作流的 AI 专家角色，可一键装进主流编码 Agent
cardLine.en: A roster of AI specialist personalities you can install into mainstream coding agents

highlights.zh: 每个 Agent 文件包含身份性格、核心任务与工作流，以及带代码示例的交付物
highlights.en: Each agent file carries identity and personality, core mission and workflows, and deliverables with code examples

highlights.zh: 角色覆盖面广，从前端开发到 Reddit 社区运营、趣味注入和现实检查
highlights.en: Wide roster: frontend work, Reddit community operations, whimsy injection and reality checks

highlights.zh: 提供桌面应用，可浏览整个角色清单并一键安装到多个 Agent，且自动更新
highlights.en: A desktop app browses the whole roster and installs into several agents with one click, keeping them updated

highlights.zh: 不装应用也行，可以把 Agent 文件当参考，挑需要的复制改写
highlights.en: No app needed either — read the agent files as reference and copy or adapt the ones you want

cons.zh: 近 90 天未发布正式 Release 版本
cons.en: No formal releases in the last 90 days

entries.quickstart:
# 摘自 msitarzewski/agency-agents 的 README
brew install --cask msitarzewski/agency-agents/agency-agents

entries.name: OmniRoute
entries.description: Never stop coding. Free MIT AI gateway: one endpoint, 359 providers (150+ free), 1200+ models Kimi, Claude, GPT, Gemini, GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode, Cline & Copilot. Quota-aware auto-fallback, RTK+Caveman compression saves 15-95% tokens, MCP/A2A, Desktop/PWA. Built by hundreds of contributors

why.zh: 近 7 天新增 1,971 star（日均约 282，相对存量增速 2.7%），累计 73,488 star、10,547 fork。窗口内被 fork 405 次，最近一次提交在 1 天前，近 30 天新建 PR 200 个、issue 200 个，430 位贡献者共同维护。
why.en: Gained 1,971 stars over the last 7 days (~282/day, 2.7% of its base), now at 73,488 stars and 10,547 forks. 405 new forks in the window; last push 1 day(s) ago; 200 PRs and 200 issues opened in the last 30 days; 430 contributors.

intro.zh: 一个免费开源的 AI 网关：把各家模型统一到一个接口后面，接上 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cline 等工具就能用。某个渠道额度用尽时会自动切到备用，还做压缩省 token；免费额度大多来自你自己的第三方账号，不用重新注册一堆服务。
intro.en: A free, MIT-licensed AI gateway that puts many providers behind one endpoint for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline and friends. When a channel runs out of quota it can fall back automatically, and compression cuts token use. Bring your own provider accounts; you connect the free tiers you are eligible for.

cardLine.zh: 免费开源 AI 网关：一个接口接入多家模型，配额感知自动切换
cardLine.en: A free open-source AI gateway: one endpoint for many providers with quota-aware fallback

highlights.zh: 一个端点聚合多家提供商和大量模型，写代码的 Agent 工具都能接上
highlights.en: One endpoint fronts many providers and models, so coding-agent tools can all connect through it

highlights.zh: 配额感知的调度与自动回退：某个渠道用尽就换下一个，尽量不打断你写代码
highlights.en: Quota-aware scheduling and auto-fallback move to the next channel instead of stopping your work

highlights.zh: 内置压缩以减少 token 消耗，并有实时配额遥测
highlights.en: Built-in compression reduces token use, with live quota telemetry

highlights.zh: 支持 MCP/A2A，提供桌面端与 PWA 界面，免费额度目录在 dashboard 里可查
highlights.en: Supports MCP/A2A and ships desktop and PWA clients, with the free-tier catalog visible on the dashboard

fitFor.zh: 希望借助 AI 辅助编程、自动化代码审查或工程提效的开发团队
fitFor.en: Development teams implementing AI coding assistants, automated code review, or dev productivity

fitFor.zh: 偏好极简终端体验、需要嵌入命令行自动化脚本的极客开发者
fitFor.en: Geek developers preferring terminal interfaces and lightweight CLI workflow automation

fitFor.zh: 想给现有工作流加一层 Agent 自动化的团队
fitFor.en: Teams adding an agent-automation layer to an existing workflow
